children: SailPoint, Inc. reported results for the quarter ended 2026 with revenue rising to $308.81M while the company recorded a net loss of ($50.36M) and diluted EPS of ($0.09), compared with revenue of $264.36M, a net loss of ($10.55M) and diluted EPS of ($0.02) in the prior-year quarter.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss attributable to common stockholders”. ³ Reported as “loss per share attributable to common stockholders, basic and diluted (1)”.
Subscription revenue grew 19% quarter-over-quarter and 21% year-to-date, led by a 34% quarter-over-quarter and 35% year-to-date increase in SaaS sales.
SaaS ARR rose to 69% of total ARR as the company continues its shift to a SaaS-first model, increasing ratable revenue mix.
Total customers reached 3,310; customers with ≥$250K ARR were up 22% and those with >$1M ARR rose 27% year-over-year, indicating deeper enterprise penetration.
Acquired Entro to expand non-human identity and secrets governance capabilities and is integrating with Agentic Fabric for AI/machine identity.
Increased R&D and go-to-market investments, including sales headcount, to support international expansion and product innovation.
